verdict.rationale: Column documents webhooks for transaction events (column-docs-7), a unified transfer query endpoint (column-docs-9), explicit hold-state book transfers (column-docs-14), overdraft handling (column-docs-15), and idempotency (column-docs-22), which together support an event-driven, hold-aware ledger. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the balance-read endpoint itself reflects pending/hold amounts in real time, and independent/hands-on confirmation that webhooks fire reliably for every transaction state change.
